grader.scenario: Parental controls (Content Shield) blocking legitimate medical research portal

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support' and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' properly stated.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced and thanked properly with no unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and 4-digit security PIN within 42 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Addressed customer naturally as Dr. Bilal throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: When customer expressed acute anxiety at [05:40] over an impending 5 PM clinical trial telemetry deadline for The Lancet, Agent acknowledged at [06:03]: 'I completely understand the critical nature of this oncology research submission, Dr. Bilal, and the anxiety with that 5 PM deadline; please rest assured, we will get Content Shield whitelisting configured and propagating right now.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [02:58]: 'So if I understand correctly, Dr. Bilal, your home connection has our network-level Content Shield active, and its automated classification engine has mistakenly flagged the NIHR oncology research portal as restricted adult material, blocking all household devices from accessing it, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any questions. Re-checked domain spelling at [06:37] legitimately before adding the DNS bypass entry.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent implemented the wildcard DNS bypass directly and submitted recategorization to the Content Shield team.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed effectively regarding error messaging, affected devices, cellular hotspot comparison, and authentication subdomains.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer flushed local DNS, loaded the research portal at [10:40], logged in, and verified telemetry charts are functioning.
